source: EU Funding & Tenders Portal calls for proposals
executive_summary: Cascade call issued by Riga Technical University (RTU) within the Skills4Deca project (Housing Decarbonisation Skills for Climate, Health and Jobs), funded by the Digital Europe Programme (grant agreement 101123311). It offers up to 40 scholarships of EUR 2,000 gross each, EUR 80,000 in total, to individual students and registered learners at higher education or vocational institutions who are nationals or residents of an EU Member State or a Digital Europe associated country. Recipients must complete three online courses (3 ECTS) on building energy and indoor air simulation, well-insulated building envelopes and residential renovation, and a three-day hackathon in Riga, between 1 February and 1 May 2027. Applications run from 9 November 2026 to 10 January 2027, 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: The call funds individual scholarships for online courses on building energy simulation, insulated building envelopes and residential renovation plus a hackathon on building decarbonisation (Skills4DECA scholarship call announcement, Eligibility and Training programme; Funding & Tenders Portal call page, Task description). No project file is close, and unlike earlier skills calls in grid or offshore engineering, these housing-retrofit skills do not build the transmission, grid-operation or offshore workforce TenneT needs, so the call does not touch TenneT's field.
